children: Polymarket’s submarket for the UFC Fight Night matchup between Ilimbek Akylbek Uulu and Mehemmedeli Osmanli saw the “Over” option in the O/U 1.5 rounds market rise sharply from 24.5% one hour earlier to 44.5% at the time of monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 20-point swing in the market’s implied probability.

title: Polymarket UFC Fight Night Over 1.5 Rounds Odds Jump 20 Points
